summary: Comprehensive methodology for High-Level SBI PO Mains Data Interpretation, percentage base-shifts, tabular extraction, and caselet venn diagrams...

blocks.content:
### 📊 Data Interpretation Core Pedagogical Framework

1. **Taxonomy of High-Level Banking DI Sets:**
   • **Missing Value Tables:** Exploit horizontal/vertical arithmetic identities ((	ext{Total} = 	ext{Male} + 	ext{Female}); (	ext{Expenditure} = 	ext{Income} - 	ext{Savings})) to reconstruct missing cells before answering.
   • **Radar / Spider Charts:** Data points represent radial distance from origin. Always verify whether polygonal grids represent absolute values or percentage shares.
   • **Arithmetic DI Caselets:** Paragraph scenarios embedding Time-Work, TSD, or Profit-Loss equations into interconnected multi-variable tables.
2. **Rapid Calculation & Approximation Filters:**
   • **Fraction-to-Percentage Equivalents:** Master ( rac{1}{7} = 14.28%), ( rac{1}{8} = 12.5%), ( rac{1}{9} = 11.11%), ( rac{1}{11} = 9.09%), ( rac{1}{13} = 7.69%), ( rac{1}{17} = 5.88%), ( rac{1}{19} = 5.26%).
   • **Percentage Base-Shift Formula:** If (A) is (x%) more than (B), then (B) is (left( rac{x}{100+x} 	imes 100ight)%) less than (A).

🎯 Exam Angle → ⚡ Percentage Comparison Trap: Always distinguish between *"A is what percent of B"* (( rac{A}{B} 	imes 100)) versus *"A is what percent MORE than B"* (( rac{A - B}{B} 	imes 100)). The denominator is ALWAYS the reference base following the word "than" or "of"!
